title: Practice: Rear Diagonal Elbow
source: Practice Mode tutorial. The owner's rear diagonal elbow: the elbow comes from high at an oblique, 45° line down. Words from the app's Technique Library (practiceData.js › Muay Thai › Rear Diagonal Elbow). Thai: Sok Chieng (ศอกเฉียง). Footage: the owner's clip 7 (ring, 2026-10-31), raw-footage/practice/p7.mp4; the rear-arm reps at about 3.7 and 5.25 s carry the key points; the body sits at the frame's edge for the first 2 s.

props.description: The diagonal cutting elbow from the rear side
props.hookSub: Rear diagonal elbow. Sok Chieng. 20 seconds.

cues.label: STEP IN
cues.say: Coach: "Elbows land at hugging range. Step in, then throw."

cues.text: Cut down and across at an angle
cues.label: DOWN & ACROSS
cues.say: Coach: "From high to low, across the face at forty-five degrees. That angle is what cuts."

cues.text: Strike with the tip, hip behind it
cues.label: THE TIP
cues.say: Coach: "The point of the elbow, and the rear hip turns into it."

watch.fix: Short and tight from the guard
watch.label: WIND-UP
watch.say: Coach: "A big wind-up tells them it's coming. It leaves from where your hand already is."

props.alias: ศอกเฉียง · SOK CHIENG
